metadata_caption: When Ellie saw herself in the mirror! 🥹😂 backstory ::: Kay has been looking for the perfect Halloween costume for Ellie’s first Halloween. She loves being able to dress Ellie up in cute outfits, and is so excited for the holiday. She dressed her up as pebbles the other day, and it was so precious, but Kay said she wanted to try a couple other ideas just to make sure that she was choosing the right first Halloween costume. I mentioned after Ellie’s bath that her hair reminded me of Dwight from the office, and that gave Kay the idea to get a costume together to look like Dwight. She told me that she had a surprise and went with Ellie to her room, after a few minutes. She called me in and Ellie was in her costume! She was so cute! 😂❤️ Ellie was so excited to be dressed up and was so giggly and happy. We showed her what she looked like in the mirror and she was shocked 😂 Kay said that she has some other costumes coming, so now I am excited to see what she will be dressed as next! ❤️ #kayandtayofficial #couples #relationships #pregnant #postpartum
